Settings.QueryText: SELECT SetRoomBlocks.Ref AS SetRoomBlock, SetRoomBlocks.Hotel, SetRoomBlocks.Room.RoomType AS RoomType, SetRoomBlocks.Room, SetRoomBlocks.RoomBlockType, SetRoomBlocks.RoomBlockType.SortCode AS RoomBlockTypeSortCode, SetRoomBlocks.DateFrom AS DateFrom, SetRoomBlocks.Duration, SetRoomBlocks.DateTo AS DateTo, 1 AS RoomsBlocked, SetRoomBlocks.Room.NumberOfBedsPerRoom AS BedsBlocked, SetRoomBlocks.Room.NumberOfBedsPerRoom AS NumberOfBedsPerRoom, SetRoomBlocks.Room.NumberOfPersonsPerRoom AS NumberOfPersonsPerRoom, SetRoomBlocks.Author, SetRoomBlocks.IsFinished, SetRoomBlocks.Remarks FROM Document.SetRoomBlock AS SetRoomBlocks WHERE SetRoomBlocks.Posted AND SetRoomBlocks.Room = &qRoom AND (&qShowAllBlocks OR NOT &qShowAllBlocks AND NOT SetRoomBlocks.IsFinished)
